Venue: Biconomy.com
Headline: 🎁 Share 400,000 CLEAR — Biconomy × Clearpool Trading Airdrop!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
## Dear Biconomy Users,
To celebrate the listing of CLEAR on Biconomy, we’re launching the Biconomy × Clearpool Earn Credits campaign with a total prize pool of 400,000 CLEAR, distributed across Four events.
Complete eligible spot or futures trading tasks to receive guaranteed CLEAR rewards while earning Credits. Credits determine your proportional share of each event’s CLEAR reward pool—the more Credits you earn, the larger your reward.
## 📅 Activity Timeline
Stage | Time (UTC)
1️⃣ Join the Event | 2026/11/28 00:00
2️⃣ Credit Earning Ends | 2026/12/4 23:59
3️⃣ CLEAR Airdrop Distributed | Within 7 business days after event ends
## ⭐ How to Participate
1️⃣ Create or sign in to your Biconomy account
2️⃣ Trade CLEAR spot or complete futures trading (based on which event(s) you qualify for)
3️⃣ Credits accumulate automatically
4️⃣ CLEAR airdrop distributed to your Spot account within 7 business days after settlement
## 🎯 Prize Pool: 400,000 CLEAR
Event | Pool | Who
🥇 Event 1 · Any Spot Trading (New Users) | 70,000 CLEAR | New sign-ups
🥈 Event 2 · CLEAR Spot Trading (All Users) | 137,500 CLEAR | Anyone
🥉 Event 3 · Futures Trading (New Users) | 70,000 CLEAR | New sign-ups
🎯 Event 4 · Futures Trading (All Users) | 122,500 CLEAR | Anyone

## 📐 How Rewards Work
## Every event gives you two things:
1. CLEAR — guaranteed once you hit the tier. Distributed within 7 business days after the event ends.
2. Credits — your share of the event's sharing pool, calculated as:
Your Share = (Your Credits ÷ Total Credits in Event) × Event Sharing Pool
## 📌 Rules
Only filled orders count. Cancelled orders do not.
Event 1 accepts any Biconomy Spot trading pair. Event 2 only counts CLEAR/USDT Spot trading.
Events 3 and 4 accept any Biconomy USDT-M Perpetual Futures trading pair.
Self-trading, wash trading, or any form of market manipulation will result in disqualification.
Biconomy reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.
